title: Palantir Foundry repository pyspark: create a column with "withColumn" and "F.expr()" in a dataframe
question:
i have a problem with an F.expr condition (CASE WHEN) in foundry repository pyspark. i must create a column with a F.expr() condition. here the condition:

this part create a dictionary of many conditions (from table with two column "condizione", "valore_output"):

regola_dict = {row["condition"]:row["output"] for row in
regola_ultima.collect()}

then i create a variable with join dictionary items

case_expr = "CASE " +
".join([f"WHEN {k} THEN '{v}'" for k, v
in regola_dict.items()]) + " ELSE
'Default' END"

it works, if i create in a dataframe a column with:

db = db.withColumn('column_test',  F.lit(case_expr))

i obtain in every rows the correct condition of CASE WHEN. if i use this condition in a dataframe in this mode:

db = db.withColumn("test"，F.expr(case_expr))

i obtain an error: PARSE_SINTAX_ERROR

i think that the problem are the '' characters , because CASE WHEN is similar to:

case when column1='N' and column2='text' then 'case1'
when .............
else 'case_final'
end

i have tried in order: adding ''' at case_expr ; because in a normal CASE WHEN i use this syntax:

'''
case when ... then
when ... then
else...
end
'''

and so the code i wrote:

case_expr = "'''CASE " + ".join([f"WHEN {k} THEN '{v}'" for k, v in regola_dict.items()]) + " ELSE
'Default' END'''"

second test:

'Default' END"

and then this syntax:

db = db.withColumn("test"，F.expr(f'''"""{case_expr}"""'''))

but i obtain error of'' ''

can you help me please? thanks

answer:
You can print the final value of the case_expr to verify that it is constructed as you expect. You can see this value in debug mode, or in the logs of your build. See https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/transforms-python/pyspark-logging#code-repositories

It's likely a quote issue, but hard to pin-down exactly what is wrong there. Still I wouldn't expect that many triple quotes in your statements.

Something along those lines should work and be simpler to debug:

# Construct the CASE WHEN expression
case_expr = "CASE " + " ".join([f"WHEN {k} THEN '{v}'" for k, v in regola_dict.items()]) + " ELSE 'Default' END"

# Print for debugging
print(case_expr)

# Use the constructed expression in F.expr
db = db.withColumn("test", F.expr(case_expr))
